expected.finding: **[P2]** Background filtering suppresses recurring defects ([line 463](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:463)). Nine findings saying “Deadlock in worker pool” produce a topic; adding the tenth excludes every keyword and produces no topics. Frequency alone cannot distinguish repository vocabulary from a common defect. Preserve tokens concentrated in a specific problem cluster.

**[P2]** The location regex introduces quadratic processing time ([line 252](/home/runner/work/open-inspect-72e95a/open-inspect-72e95a/scripts/revise-improvement-policy.py:252)). The unanchored `\S+` alternatives repeatedly scan long whitespace-free strings when no path matches. Reproduction took 0.132 seconds for 8,000 characters, 0.527 seconds for 16,000, and 8.491 seconds for 64,000. Long diagnostic strings can stall archive mining, which tokenizes findings repeatedly. Split whitespace-delimited chunks first and inspect each once.
